synthesis.key_insight: The codebase exhibits a deliberate 'write once, deploy everywhere' strategy with packages/ui serving as the gravitational center—809 files of shared React infrastructure that powers marketing sites, documentation, enterprise dashboards, VS Code extensions, and third-party plugin ecosystems. This creates strong coherence but reveals tension in the Tauri desktop app (src/codrag/dashboard) which maintains parallel hook implementations rather than consuming packages/ui directly, and the VS Code webview which suppresses type safety with explicit 'any' annotations. The four-site Next.js monorepo (marketing/docs/support/payments) demonstrates mature shared infrastructure, while the Paperclip plugin shows strategic ecosystem expansion. Most critical gap: license management exhibits 'dual-source-of-truth pattern' per src/codrag/dashboard analysis, suggesting synchronization risks between desktop app and web payment flows.
